module_metadata.purpose: Maps legacy Godot 3.x / 4.0-4.4 patterns to exact Godot 4.7 standards and enforces the 5 battle-tested runtime & QA guardrails.

critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.title: Godot 4.7 Packed*Array Indexed Mutation Breaking Change
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.correct_4_7:
var pts: PackedVector2Array = line_2d.points
pts[0] = Vector2(10, 20)
line_2d.points = pts
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.reason: In Godot 4.7, mutating an individual index of a `Packed*Array` property (`points[i] = v`, `polygon[i] = v`) no longer triggers the node property's setter. You MUST mutate a local copy and reassign the full property.

critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.title: GDScript Lambda Primitive Value-Capture Trap
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.wrong:
var fired: bool = false
sig.connect(func() -> void: fired = true) # 'fired' in outer scope stays false!
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.correct:
var probe: Dictionary[StringName, Variant] = {&"fired": false}
sig.connect(func() -> void: probe[&"fired"] = true) # Mutates reference dictionary!
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.reason: GDScript closures capture local primitive types (`bool`, `int`, `float`, `String`, `Vector2`) by VALUE at closure creation time. Always capture a `Dictionary`, `Array`, or `Object` reference when recording state inside a signal lambda.

critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.title: DirectSpaceState Queries Must Run Inside _physics_process()
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.wrong:
func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	var space := get_world_2d().direct_space_state # Unsafe outside physics tick!
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.reason: Accessing `get_world_2d().direct_space_state` or `get_world_3d().direct_space_state` inside `_process()` or `_input()` can collide with locked physics servers or stale broadphase data.

critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.title: Use Control.offset_transform_* for UI Animations Inside Containers
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.correct:
button_in_vbox.offset_transform_enabled = true
tween.tween_property(button_in_vbox, ^"offset_transform_position", Vector2(0.0, -10.0), 0.2)
tween.tween_property(button_in_vbox, ^"offset_transform_scale", Vector2(1.08, 1.08), 0.2)
critical_godot_4_7_guardrails.reason: New in Godot 4.7: `offset_transform_position`, `offset_transform_scale`, `offset_transform_rotation`, and `offset_transform_pivot` animate Controls visually without fighting parent Containers or shifting mouse hitboxes.

replacements.KinematicBody2D / KinematicBody: CharacterBody2D / CharacterBody3D (or AnimatableBody2D/3D for moving platforms)
replacements.move_and_slide(velocity, UP): move_and_slide() (zero arguments; set built-in `velocity` property first)
replacements.TileMap: TileMapLayer (use `set_cell(coords, source_id, atlas_coords, alt_tile)` with NO layer index)
